'''Sachi Kokuryū''' (Japanese: '''國立幸''' ''Kokuryū Sachi'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Kokuryū was born on July 9, 1984 in {{wp|Saitama Prefecture|Saitama}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as an adult. She joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|SM}}, voicing {{an|Professor Kukui}}'s wife and recurring character {{an|Professor Burnet}}. She is currently affiliated with the {{wp|Himawari Theatre Group}}.
